Name: Aspect of Invidiva
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
Twin aspect of Lussuria, Invidiva the Grasping oversees bandits, thieves and bloodstained assassins. She embodies covetous action guided by a complete lack of conscience, and her legacy is best represented in the form of the Red Manor organization: a network of connected assassins who take on jobs too grizzly and violent for even the Family’s Tailors. Invidiva takes a dark pleasure in convincing others to pass their moral event horizons and indulge in their most unspeakable thoughts.

The Red Manor serves as her followers and agents in the Material Plane, and like her sister, Invidiva occasionally incarnates by possessing the most capable of the order. As a lesser god she can occasionally project her aspect directly into the Material Plane, however, taking advantage of a loophole in her godhood; where most gods require a divine realm, she has none. Her essence is instead bound to godhood by her sister’s realm - the Glade of Forbidden Pleasures. Since she has no realm and lacks proper planar influence, the divine curtain doesn’t restrict Invidiva fully. However, if her aspect is destroyed, it takes her longer to project one again than most gods. Despite having no divine realm, she does have a stronghold in the Realm of Shadow, in a location that mirrors her sister’s Glade in the Fey Realm.

Invidiva’s greatest desire is to steal from her sister. She is the embodiment of lustful desire that drove their original archfey self to seek godhood, and when they separated she was left with an unquenchable desire to be whole again. Her Red Manor frequently attacks, kills members of, and steals from the Celestial Brothel, and Invidiva searches for a way to bind her sister long enough to subsume her godhood, aiming to become a full god without her twin in the picture. Each time she has ever tried, however, she has been humiliated.

traits.name: Lady of the Binding Chain
traits.description: Invidiva can use her Acrobatics skill in place of Athletics when attempting to grapple another creature.

traits.name: Vanishing Desires (Mythic Awakening)
traits.description: If Invidiva is reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, her current hit point total resets to 150, and she ends any magical effects targeting her that she wishes to escape. She then teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet, regains her Legendary Reactions, and can use her Mythic Actions for 1 hour. During that hour she adds her Dexterity modifier to her armor class a second time as long as she isn’t wearing medium or heavy armor, and has a second reaction to use each round. A party that defeats her after using her Vanishing Desires is awarded an additional 20,000 XP (40,000 XP total).

**ASPECT OF INVIDIVA**
*Medium fey (shapechanger), chaotic neutral*
**Armor Class** 17 (natural armor)
**Hit Points** 182 (28d8 + 56)
**Speed** 40 ft., fly (hover) 60 ft., teleport 30 ft.
**Quality Traits** Critical 19, deific, evasion, magic resist
**STR** 16 (+3) | **DEX** 20 (+5) | **CON** 15 (+2) | **INT** 16 (+3) | **WIS** 22 (+6) | **CHA** 16 (+3)
**Saving Throws** Dex +11, Int +9, Cha +9
**Skills** Acrobatics +11, Perception +12, Stealth +11
**Immunities** poison; B/S/P (magical)
**Condition Immunities** charmed, exhaustion, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned
**Senses** truesight 30 ft., darkvision 240 ft., passive Perception 22
**Languages** all
**Challenge Rating** 18 (20,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +6

***Lady of the Binding Chain.*** Invidiva can use her Acrobatics skill in place of Athletics when attempting to grapple another creature.

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS (3 USES)**
TBA.

***Vanishing Desires (Mythic Awakening).*** If Invidiva is reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, her current hit point total resets to 150, and she ends any magical effects targeting her that she wishes to escape. She then teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet, regains her Legendary Resistances, and can use her Mythic Actions for 1 hour. During that hour she adds her Dexterity modifier to her armor class a second time as long as she isn’t wearing medium or heavy armor, and has a second reaction to use each round. A party that defeats her after using her Vanishing Desires is awarded an additional 20,000 XP (40,000 XP total).

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** Invidiva makes three Hyacinth Bladed Chain attacks.

***Hyacinth Bladed Chain.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 6 (1d10) poison damage. The first time a given creature is hit by this weapon each turn, they must attempt a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 36 (8d8) poison damage.

***Mythic Action: Winds of Chaining Death (Recharge 6).*** Invidiva vanishes, moving as quickly as a surging hurricane wind, forcing all creatures she chooses in a 30-foot-radius centered on herself to make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. Each creature who fails takes 33 (6d10) slashing damage and is grappled as though by her Snap Chain bonus action, or takes half as much damage and isn’t grappled on a successful one. Invidiva then reappears in any unoccupied space within the radius, and her movement for the remainder of the turn is spent.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** Invidiva transforms to assume the physical characteristics of any Small, Medium or Large humanoid creature, or back to her true form. She retains all of her statistics (apart from her size), and if she is reduced to 0 hit points she returns to her true form.

***Cunning Action.*** Invidiva takes the Dash or Disengage action.

***Snap Chain.*** When Invidiva is grappling a creature, she can magically lengthen her bladed chain and snap off the section binding them, allowing her to continue grappling them (escape DC 19). While grappled this way they are restrained (escape DC 19), and when they begin their turn grappled this way they take 5 (1d8) slashing damage and 5 (1d8) poison damage.

**REACTIONS**
***Eerie Dodge.*** Invidiva takes half damage from an attack targeting her that she can see, and is resistant to damage from that attack’s source until the start of her next turn.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Damning Whispers.*** One creature Invidiva can see must succeed a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw as their mind is filled with intrusive whispers preying on their unspoken fears. On a failure, they imagine Invidiva as a key element of those fears and are frightened of her until the end of her next turn.

***Hidden Steps (Costs 2 Actions).*** Invidiva becomes invisible until the end of her next turn and immediately moves up to 30 feet.

**MYTHIC ACTIONS**
Invidiva can use the following as Legendary Action options for 1 hour after activating her Mythic Awakening.

***Space Shift.*** Invidiva teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space adjacent to a creature she can see, and makes a Hyacinth Bladed Chain attack against them.

***Cascading Pendulum (Costs 2 Actions).*** Invidiva chooses two creatures within 40 feet of her: each must succeed a DC 19 Strength saving throw. Each that fails is hoisted by bladed chains she conjures, is hurled through the air, and takes 11 (2d10) slashing damage. If both fail they are slammed into each other in the air, and take an additional 20 (3d12) bludgeoning damage. Each that failed is then dropped into an unoccupied space that can fit them within 40 feet, where they fall prone.
